device_family: ABB ACS880 industrial drives (primary control program)
provenance_default: Seeded from general knowledge of the ABB ACS880 primary control program firmware manual. UNVERIFIED: check code + remedy against the manual matching the drive's installed FW revision (Drive Composer Pro > System info) before use in any customer-facing document.

entries.name: Overcurrent
entries.text_en: Output current has exceeded the internal fault limit.
entries.text_de: Ausgangsstrom hat die interne Fehlergrenze überschritten.
entries.cause: Too-short acceleration ramp, shock load, motor/cable fault, wrong motor data, or an output-side contactor opened under load.
entries.remedy: Check motor load and mechanics; lengthen acceleration time (23.12); check motor and motor cable (phase-to-phase, phase-to-earth); verify motor nameplate data in group 99; ensure no contactor switches in the motor cable during run.

entries.name: Earth leakage
entries.text_en: Load unbalance, typically an earth fault in motor or motor cable.
entries.text_de: Erdschluss — Unsymmetrie, typischerweise Erdfehler in Motor oder Motorkabel.
entries.cause: Insulation failure in motor or motor cable; excessive cable capacitance to earth.
entries.remedy: Megger the motor and motor cable (disconnect from drive first); check cable routing and length vs. the drive's EMC/cable specs; if measurements are clean, contact ABB service.

entries.name: Short circuit
entries.text_en: Short circuit detected in motor or motor cable.
entries.text_de: Kurzschluss in Motor oder Motorkabel erkannt.
entries.cause: Phase-to-phase or phase-to-earth short in the motor circuit; failed output stage.
entries.remedy: Do NOT reset and restart blindly. Isolate and measure motor + cable insulation; fix the short; if the fault persists with a healthy motor circuit, the inverter unit needs service.

entries.name: Input phase loss
entries.text_en: DC link ripple indicates a missing input phase or blown fuse.
entries.text_de: Netzphasenausfall — Zwischenkreis-Welligkeit deutet auf fehlende Eingangsphase oder defekte Sicherung.
entries.cause: Blown supply fuse, loose supply connection, supply unbalance.
entries.remedy: Check supply fuses and all input power connections; measure the three input phases under load; check supply unbalance against the drive's rating.

entries.name: Wiring or earth fault
entries.text_en: Incorrect input power / motor cabling detected, or an earth fault.
entries.text_de: Verdrahtungs- oder Erdschlussfehler — falsche Netz-/Motorverkabelung erkannt.
entries.cause: Input power connected to drive output, or earth fault on the drive output side.
entries.remedy: Verify the power wiring: supply on input terminals, motor on output terminals; check for earth faults in the motor circuit.

entries.name: DC link overvoltage
entries.text_en: Intermediate-circuit DC voltage exceeded the fault limit.
entries.cause: Deceleration ramp too short for the load inertia (regenerative energy), supply overvoltage/transients, or missing/failed brake chopper-resistor.
entries.remedy: Lengthen deceleration time (23.13); enable/verify overvoltage control (30.30); fit or check brake chopper + resistor; check supply voltage level and transients.

entries.name: DC link undervoltage
entries.text_en: Intermediate-circuit DC voltage fell below the fault limit.
entries.cause: Supply dip or interruption, blown input fuse, weak supply under load.
entries.remedy: Check the supply voltage and fuses; investigate plant-side dips (large DOL starts on the same feeder); consider the undervoltage-control / power-loss ride-through functions.

entries.name: IGBT overtemperature
entries.text_en: Estimated or measured IGBT temperature is excessive.
entries.text_de: IGBT-Übertemperatur — geschätzte oder gemessene Temperatur zu hoch.
entries.cause: Blocked/failed cooling fan, dirty heatsink, high ambient temperature, overload, switching frequency too high for load.
entries.remedy: Check cooling fan operation and heatsink cleanliness; verify ambient temperature and cabinet ventilation vs. derating tables; reduce load or switching frequency per manual.

entries.name: Excess temperature
entries.text_en: Power unit module temperature is excessive.
entries.cause: Cooling failure, blocked airflow, ambient over spec, sustained overload.
entries.remedy: Check fans, air filters, and cabinet airflow; verify ambient and load profile; let the unit cool before reset and find the root cause — do not just reset repeatedly.

entries.name: STO hardware failure
entries.text_en: Safe torque off hardware diagnostics detected a failure.
entries.text_de: STO-Hardwarefehler — Diagnose der sicheren Drehmomentabschaltung meldet Fehler.
entries.cause: Fault in the STO circuit (channel mismatch, wiring, supervision).
entries.remedy: SAFETY FUNCTION — do not bypass or jumper. Diagnose the STO wiring and both channels per the drive hardware manual's STO section; the safety function must be re-validated after repair (see SAFETY.md — this is certified-path territory).

entries.name: Safe torque off active
entries.text_en: STO is active while the drive was commanded to run.
entries.text_de: Safe Torque Off aktiv, während ein Startbefehl anlag.
entries.cause: STO circuit opened (e-stop chain, safety relay) or one STO channel lost.
entries.remedy: SAFETY FUNCTION — establish WHY the safety chain opened before any reset; check both STO channels and their supply; never defeat the chain to keep production running (SAFETY.md / H11).

entries.name: Motor stall
entries.text_en: Motor is operating in the stall region.
entries.cause: Mechanical jam or overload; undersized motor/drive for the load; wrong stall supervision settings.
entries.remedy: Inspect the mechanics for jams; check load vs. motor/drive sizing; review stall supervision settings (group 31) against the real duty.

entries.name: Overspeed
entries.text_en: Motor speed exceeded the allowed maximum.
entries.cause: Overhauling load driving the motor, wrong speed limits (30.11/30.12), ramp/regeneration misconfiguration.
entries.remedy: Check minimum/maximum speed limits and the overspeed trip margin (31.30); verify the load cannot overhaul the motor (crane/hoist: check brake sequencing); check encoder feedback if used.

entries.name: IGBT overtemperature (warning)
entries.text_en: IGBT temperature approaching the fault limit.
entries.cause: Same as fault 4210, at warning level.
entries.remedy: Treat as early warning of 4210: check cooling, ambient, load before it trips.

entries.name: Safe torque off (warning)
entries.cause: STO opened while the drive was not running, or STO indication parameter set to warning.
entries.remedy: SAFETY FUNCTION — identify why the safety chain is open; check both STO channels; never bypass (SAFETY.md / H11).
